folder.why: Masculine anglicism singular 'Folder' clashes with the feminine plural 'Carpetas' and g='f'; singular aligned to the same dictionary lemma (la carpeta / las carpetas). Mexican-register valid classroom term.

apple-pie.why: Head noun 'pay' (Mexican) pluralizes as 'pays', not 'payes'; the modifier 'de manzana' is invariable.

erlenmeyer-flask.why: matraz->matraces correct (-z->-ces), but 'Erlenmeyer' is an invariable proper-name modifier; machine pluralized it to the non-word 'Erlenmeyeres'. Should stay invariable.

guinea-pig.why: Plural was a different lemma than the singular 'Cuyo'; plural must match the singular lemma (el cuyo / los cuyos, +s).
guinea-pig.src: WordReference: cuyo (noun sense = conejillo de Indias); regular +s

kite.why: Singular is Mexican 'Papalote' but plural was the Peninsular lemma 'Cometas'; plural must match the singular. Dict gives mpl papalotes.

pie.why: MX 'pay' (pie) pluralizes as loan +s, not native -yes; 'Payes' is incorrect

manatee.why: noun ending in stressed -í takes -es plural; 'Manatís' is the colloquial variant, dict prefers manatíes

scooter.why: unadapted English loan; Mexican plural adds -s, not -es (*scooteres is malformed)

snorkel.why: unadapted loan keeping English spelling takes -s; *snorkeles is not standard (RAE adapts as esnórquel/esnórqueles)

pretzel.why: unadapted German/English loan; natural plural is pretzels, not *pretzeles (not in RAE)

swordfish.why: N+N apposition compound: only the head noun pluralizes; second element stays singular. RAE/DPD: 'pez espada' → 'peces espada'.

teddy-bear.why: Singular is diminutive 'osito' but plural dropped the diminutive; s/p must agree → 'ositos de peluche'.

tuna.why: Singular 'atún' is aguda ending in -n (accent required); plural 'atunes' is llana ending in -s (no accent).

turkey.why: Singular is Mexican-register 'guajolote'; plural must match the same lemma → 'guajolotes' (not the peninsular 'pavos').

vase.why: Singular 'florero' but plural switched lemma to 'jarrones'; s/p must agree → 'floreros'.

cross.why: cruz is feminine (la cruz); current 'm' is wrong. Singular/plural (Cruz/Cruces) already correct.

kite.why: 'Papalote' is masculine (el papalote); the f gender came from the mismatched Peninsular 'cometa' (f).

potato-chips.why: papas fritas / la papa is feminine

pruning-shears.why: tijeras / la tijera is feminine (cf. scissors already f)

santa.why: Santa Claus is a male referent; el Santa Claus

santa-claus.why: Santa Claus is a male referent; el Santa Claus

vegetables.why: 'verdura' is feminine (la verdura / las verduras); WordReference marks (nf).
